title: feat(fields,app-shell,plugin-detail): a pointer whose target the platform deleted draws a tombstone in the declared option's label (objectui#12489)
body:
Fixes #12489
Clause-②: yes

Step 4 of objectui#12489, the build ruling A item 3 calls for (ruling `6203737086`): the record pointer renderer draws the tombstone from the option's own label when the platform asserts the target was deleted. It reads nothing and links nothing. `RecordPreviewCard`'s "the caller renders it" rule is unchanged, and the pointer renderer is that caller.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/fields`**: `resolveRecordPointer(field, row, optionsOf?)` reads `@objectstack/spec`'s `FieldSchema.referenceDeletedWhen: { field, value }` beside `referenceVia`. When the row's sibling `select` holds the declared option, the returned `RecordPointer` carries `deletedLabel`: that option's label, looked up in the options the call site supplies. The predicate is evaluated here and nowhere else. With no `optionsOf`, or no option with that value, the pair comes back as before; the raw option value is never used as the text. The default face under `RECORD_POINTER_CARD_TYPE` draws the label in place of the record id.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail`**: `DetailSection` passes the object field's `referenceDeletedWhen` and the sibling's options, translated with the same `translateOptions` call the grid already uses for `select` options. So the tombstone reads the way the option reads in its own cell, localized labels included. It adds no i18n key.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: the pointer face draws a pair carrying `deletedLabel` as a tombstone (`data-record-pointer="deleted"`, a wastebasket icon, the label, in the card's frame) and does not mount `RecordPreviewCard`. It makes no record read and no definition read, draws no link and shows no id.
- Docs: `content/docs/guide/fields.md` and `packages/fields/README.md`.

**Clause-②: yes (widening).** `RecordPointer` gains the optional `deletedLabel`. `resolveRecordPointer`'s field parameter gains the optional `referenceDeletedWhen`, and the function gains an optional third parameter, `optionsOf`. Nothing narrows: every existing call and return shape type-checks and resolves as before. There is no new export.

## The four states on the served page, against the sheet's pins

`approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageReferenceStates-12489.test.tsx` uses the real `RecordDetailView` on the app-scoped record route, through `ApprovalRecordReads`, under the root `SchemaRendererProvider` as `ConsoleShell` mounts it, with objectstack's `sys_approval_request_detail` page copied whole. The request definition carries the services declaration (`record_id` declares `{ field: 'cancel_reason', value: 'record_deleted' }`) and the contract's `cancel_reason` labels.

| State | Sheet pin | Served page (measured) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| readable | `recordLink`: link | one link to the record path, inside the card, named by the title |
| refused (403) | `recordLinkRefused-11878`: no link, keeps the snapshot title | no link; the card's cause-free "This record cannot be opened"; snapshot title not drawn (see notes) |
| deleted (platform-asserted) | `tombstone`: "Related record deleted", no link, no bare id | the same label, 0 target reads, no link, id absent from the tombstone and the Details tab |
| unresolvable | `unresolvableReference`: "This record cannot be opened" | the same text, no link, no id in the card |

Controls: a cancelled row with no `cancel_reason` reads the target and draws the card; a 404 on a row the platform did not flag draws no tombstone. A zh-CN bundle draws the tombstone as the localized option label. The sheet (`ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`) and its four pins are untouched.

## Evidence

- Test union at head `b78ab082` (`packages/fields/`, `packages/plugin-detail/`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/record-preview/`, every `approvalRequestsDataSource.*` test, and the four sheet pins): Test Files 552 passed, 2 skipped (554); Tests 6937 passed, 21 skipped (6958).
- Ablations, each confirmed on disk and restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - predicate forced false: 9 failed;
  - a target read made anyway in the tombstone branch: 3 failed (the zero-read pins);
  - label taken from the raw option value: 8 failed;
  - the call site skips `translateOptions`: 2 failed (the localized pins).
- Closure build `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell...'`: exit 0.
- `type-check`: exit 0 for fields, plugin-detail, app-shell and console. Console needed five plugin dists built first; they are outside the closure.
- Exit 0 for `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:spec-symbols`, changeset presence and new line citations.
- eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.
- NOT MEASURED: a live reading. Published `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.2` lacks the services declaration (objectstack PR #23798), so a live request page cannot show the predicate yet; the served-page harness is the evidence.

## Acceptance notes

- The refused state on the served page shows the card's cause-free text and no snapshot title, while the sheet keeps the title as plain text. A refused read still never yields a link. Left to objectui#12484.
- The sheet's tombstone also shows `record_title` on its meta line; the served tombstone is the option label alone, per the ruling. Left to objectui#12484.
- The served predicate is the single declared condition (`cancel_reason` = `record_deleted`). The sheet also checks `status` = `cancelled`; the contract declares `cancel_reason` present only on cancelled rows.
- The page H1 (`display_title`) shows the raw record id in every state. objectui#12484 carries it.
